page.title: Leave management
page.subtitle: Manage leave types, leave profiles, employee sets and year close within this HR group.
page.empty: No types have been configured yet.
page.emptyDescription: Add a type to configure the leave engine.
page.colorOverviewDescription: See which colours are already assigned to leave and work-hour types.
page.noColorUsage: No colour codes are in use yet.

workspace.typesIntro: Manage leave types, work hours and their accrual rules.
workspace.profilesIntro: A leave profile bundles the rules that apply to employees.
workspace.priorityIntro: Define the order in which leave cohorts are consumed for each leave profile.
workspace.setsIntro: Use employee sets for a controlled deviation from the default profile.
workspace.migrationIntro: Record the transferred balance as the authoritative state at the start date, preserving separate expiry cohorts.
workspace.correctionsIntro: Record auditable HR corrections without changing original accrual or migration balances.
workspace.yearEndIntro: Close leave years and inspect the immutable balance ledger.

openingBalance.title: Opening balances and migration
openingBalance.description: A migration opening balance is the authoritative balance at the start date. LiquidHR calculates from that date onward and keeps expiry cohorts separate.
openingBalance.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the source of the transferred balance
openingBalance.confirmDescription: This becomes the authoritative balance at the start date. LiquidHR will not accrue before that date.
openingBalance.saved: The migration opening balance was recorded.
openingBalance.failed: The migration opening balance could not be recorded.
openingBalance.invalidExpiration: The expiry date must be after the start date.
openingBalance.noEmployees: No authorised employees with an active employment were found.

accrualRun.title: Calculate and post leave accrual
accrualRun.description: Review the calculation per employee and period first. Posting creates only the displayed delta as an immutable accrual transaction.
accrualRun.empty: Choose a year and calculate a preview to review accrual.
accrualRun.updated: Accrual was posted and checked again.
accrualRun.failed: The leave accrual could not be processed.

rule.description: Edit an existing rule directly or add a new rule using the latest rule's values.
rule.contractHoursHelp: Stores the annual accrual at 100% FTE; frequency distributes it across periods and the part-time factor is applied separately.
rule.workedHoursHelp: Calculates accrual from submitted work hours.
rule.annualFullTimeEntitlementHelp: The total leave entitlement per calendar year for a full-time employment. LiquidHR distributes it automatically according to the selected accrual frequency.
rule.calculatedPreviewHelp: This is informational; the amount per period is not configured separately.
rule.calculatedPayrollPeriod: LiquidHR automatically distributes the annual entitlement according to the employment's payroll period.
rule.partialPeriodHelp: When employment starts or ends during an accrual period, LiquidHR calculates the partial period pro rata by calendar days.
rule.partialPeriodMonthly: Monthly: days employed in the month / calendar days in that month.
rule.partialPeriodFourWeekly: Four-weekly: days employed in the period / 28.
rule.rateHelp: Enter the amount as a decimal with up to 8 digits after the decimal separator. This is an amount per hour, not an FTE factor.
rule.workHoursHelp: Select one or more work-hour types that this accrual is based on.
rule.pauseHelp: Choose zero or more leave types that pause this accrual.
rule.noPauseTypes: No other leave types are available.
rule.profileRequired: No active default leave profile exists for this HR group. Configure a default profile first.
